description: Ask Clearline a life insurance question in your own words and get a plain-English education answer: term or whole life for new parents, what a beneficiary is, whether renters need coverage, how long coverage should last. The answers are written and checked by William Litner, FCAS, a licensed Washington life insurance producer (WA license #1392436). This tool answers questions and explains; it does not calculate a coverage gap and does no new math itself. If the question is really a sizing question, it points you to how_much_life_insurance_do_i_need; if it is about coverage through a job, it points you to is_my_work_coverage_enough — and in both cases it names the facts to collect first. It never names an insurance company, never recommends a policy, never tells you what to buy, and asks no health questions. Nothing you type is saved.

question.description: The life insurance question, in the asker's own words. One question per call.
